info.title: General information
info.description: Overview and requirements for the EEPROM Emulation utility.

description.title: Description
description.description: General description of the EEPROM Emulation utility.

actions.message: This entry is displayed for information only and cannot be edited.

description.default: EEPROM Emulation provides an abstraction layer that emulates EEPROM on STM32 FLASH memory. It enables the application to store and retrieve data persistently without dedicated EEPROM hardware.

recommendation.title: Mandatory requirements

actions.message: This entry is displayed for information only and cannot be edited.

recommendation.default: In Valid start addresses, identify a listed page start address and enter it in Start address. Ensure the number of variables and cycles does not exceed the available FLASH area size.

flash_type.title: Selected algorithm for
flash_type.description: Algorithm used by EEPROM Emulation. This value is automatically derived from the STM32 device capabilities.

actions.message: This entry is displayed for information only and cannot be edited.
Selected algorithm is set to NVM when the device provides an NVM peripheral.
